mainText: Good morning. Futures are lower this morning, with Monday's rally cooling. The S and P 500 is down seven tenths of a percent, the Dow is down three tenths of a percent, and the Nasdaq 100 is down one point three percent. The ten-year Treasury yield is about four point nine one percent, down about four basis points from Monday's close. In premarket movers, Insmed is up fourteen percent on a Sanofi deal, Agilent is up seven percent on earnings, H P E is down eleven percent on margin concerns, Semtech is down eight percent despite a third-quarter beat, and Nvidia is down five percent, cooling after its big Monday jump.
